_about: Japan's seat (a seats file, laid by src/campaign/far-rows.ts while the far side's switch is on; kept by hand by the Japan and Pacific thread of 24 November 2026). What a player who takes Japan plays for, and what the Pacific adds to America's own goals. Ruling 196, points 6 and 7 (the design director, 17 November 2026, on the Pacific planner's paper 06): Japan's short campaign is 'Oil for the fleet' (Singapore, Manila, Batavia and Palembang by the end of May 1942, month 33), its long one 'The ring holds' (Tokyo, Okinawa, Saipan and Palembang still Japan's when 1946 opens); America's long campaign gains Japan and the title 'Victory on two oceans'. Goals judge a war and never change it (goals.ts): no computer country reads them. 'USA+' lays its lines over America's long goal as goals.json has it: Germany stays in 'beaten' and Japan joins it. 'tech' (ruling 68(a), the standing rule that nothing is reserved to one country: 'Japan and America get starting lists, not private technologies'): Japan opens September 1939 holding the four rows in 'start' and, as every other great power does, with two research teams; its staff's order of branches puts the army's arms first, then the sea and the air. See '_seed'.
_seed: Japan's starting list is the historian's seed of 25 November 2026 (historian/japan-seed-checks-1125.md, each row read against the tree's own words for it, marks L): anti-tank guns (the Type 94 37 mm of 1936, four to an infantry regiment, which stopped BT tanks at Nomonhan), medium bombers (the G3M and the Ki-21), carrier aviation (six carriers in commission) and ocean-going submarines (the I-boats). Not held in 1939, so earned in the tree as any country earns it: the tank arm ('tanks gathered into divisions of their own': Japan's first tank divisions formed in June 1942, and Nomonhan's two tank regiments were dissolved) and monoplane fighters ('enclosed cockpits, retracting wheels': the A5M and the Ki-27 had neither; the Zero entered service in 1940). Left out as before: motorised infantry (the army marched and rode the rails), landing craft (already given from the first month by the dated row in far-pacific-war.json and the national ability, so a row here would count it twice), heavy guns worked to one fire plan, staff colleges and airborne forces (the raiding regiments form in 1941). The two research teams are the tree's rule for a great power; the staff's order of branches is a row of the tree's own 'ai.order', as every other great power's is, and is the historian's read of 25 November 2026 (historian/pacific-forms2-reads-1125.md, part 4; derived by him from a likely source, the equipment money of 1936 to 1940 in millions of yen): the army's arms first (58 to 73% of equipment spending in 1938 to 1940), the navy second (27 to 42%, and rising), the air third (derived, no longer from memory: the historian's later read has aircraft about even inside both services' money and 8.2% of manufacturing in 1941; the design director's 04:25Z of 25 November 2026, the order unchanged), industry fourth (the small machinery and tools line), doctrine last (no money line of its own). Ruled by the design director at 03:22Z as the first day's order, by the same means as the other great powers. It replaces his first order from memory (the sea, the air, industry, the army's arms, doctrine). The order is one weight among several in the staff's choice (tech.ts staffPick): a staff short of oil, bombed by night or facing tanks still takes up what it needs first.

short.title: Oil for the fleet
short.text: Hold Singapore, Manila, Batavia and Palembang by the end of May 1942.

long.title: The ring holds
long.text: Tokyo, Okinawa, Saipan and Palembang are still Japan's when 1946 opens.

long.title: Victory on two oceans
long.text: Germany and Japan are beaten by the end of 1945, with an American army on the continent and Washington still yours.
